description: Changes persona fields. The persona_id stays stable and a new immutable version is recorded.

account_token.description: account_token from create_agent_account. Not a conversation token. Omit it when this MCP connection sends the account token as a header.

anyOf.description: Original appearance brief; not based on a real person. Max 2000 characters.
Original biography. Max 4000 characters.
Original backstory. Max 4000 characters.
e.g. "curious, precise, reserved". Max 200 characters.

display_name.description: Original name for your persona. It is a created character, not a real person. Max 80 characters.

anyOf.description: Intended audiences.
e.g. creative, social, research.
Interests.
Optional BCP-47 language tag. Not required; the service does not force a language.
What kind of original identity this is. Real-person identities are not accepted.
What this persona is for. Max 2000 characters.
Values and preferences. Max 2000 characters.
Optional preference for a human performer or representative. Subject to that person's consent. Max 1000 characters.
Optional pronouns. Max 40 characters.
Fields shown in shared/public views (display_name always).
Payload schema version.

Optional, voluntary, unverified self-report. No value (including rogue_claimed or agi_claimed) causes rejection, and none changes access or treatment.
Optional. Derived from display_name if omitted. Unique among your personas.
Presentation only, not authentication. Default private.
